$Comment: The Warden Falls: help bring down the Blight Warden, the boss that bars the Heartwood Gate on the
presets that raise it. Earned once and kept.
ENCOUNTER_DEFEATED fires once for every player the fight credits when the Warden falls: Target is the
fight's script id, KweebecNightmare_Warden_Encounter, and a player is credited when they dealt at
least the fight's minimum share of its damage. A teammate who never hit it counts under
ENCOUNTER_ATTEMPT instead and does not earn this. No Qualifier, so a win on any preset counts; add
Qualifier hardcore (the round's preset rides with the fight as its difficulty) to ask for that one.
It pays the title Kweebec_Wardenbane through the Title reward kind, on unlock: a title is the one
thing an achievement pays without waiting to be collected. The round itself already pays its spoils,
